description:
How to build systems of several LazyAnalysis applications: one instance reading devices all over a
        network, several processes on one computer, edge PCs and servers on a private network, and edge,
        manager and boss hierarchies. Covers the links between applications (distributed MQTT, Sparkplug,
        HTTP, WebSocket, UDP, TCP, ROS), equipment writes, heartbeats and watchdogs, complete .lazydeploy
        examples (checked by the launcher) and the exact commands that launch a deployment or one application
        on a computer or edge PC, by hand or as a service. topic: topologies, links, writes, launching, steps,
        or an example (same_computer, plant_network, edge_manager_boss); empty for everything. Composing only:
        this server never starts, installs or authorizes anything.
        Example: describe_distributed_systems(topic="plant_network") for a complete multi-computer deployment, or topic="launching" for the commands.
